يعترضون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَرِضُونَ (yaʕtariḍūna) /jaʕ.ta.ri.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# يُعْتَرَضُونَ (yuʕtaraḍūna) /juʕ.ta.ra.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
